units.source: Slash commands is a feature of __TRILIUM_PH_0__Text__TRILIUM_PH_1__ notes which allows easily accessing commonly used commands simply by using the keyboard, without having to remember dedicated __TRILIUM_PH_2__Keyboard Shortcuts__TRILIUM_PH_3__.

As the name suggests, to trigger the slash commands simply press the / key to trigger it. Note that this can be anywhere in a paragraph as long as it's not part of the word, if it doesn't show up simply press a space and press the / key again.
Use ↑ and ↓ keys to navigate between options.
By default, the full list of commands is displayed.
To search, simply start typing: commands are found by their title or by other names they go by (for example __TRILIUM_PH_0__ for __TRILIUM_PH_1__Heading 2__TRILIUM_PH_2__).
To trigger the highlighted action, press Enter or Tab.

With the fixed __TRILIUM_PH_0__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_1__, the block handle beside an empty paragraph turns into a __TRILIUM_PH_2__ button. Clicking it opens the commands that insert content or turn the paragraph into another block, such as a heading, a list, a table or a link, as a menu, with a box at its top that finds them by their title, their description or the other names they go by. The commands that only change the paragraph, such as alignment or indentation, are left out of that menu.

The menu of the block handle, described in __TRILIUM_PH_0__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_1__, starts with __TRILIUM_PH_2__Insert above__TRILIUM_PH_3__ and __TRILIUM_PH_4__Insert below__TRILIUM_PH_5__, which list the same commands and add the one picked in a new paragraph above or below the block. Beside a list item, items that add an empty list item take their place.

units.source: Apart from the common set of commands, some features are specially integrated with the slash commands:
units.context: Slash Commands > Integration with other features

units.source: For __TRILIUM_PH_0__admonitions__TRILIUM_PH_1__, each admonition type (e.g. note, tip) will be individually displayed.
units.context: Slash Commands > Integration with other features

units.source: Every __TRILIUM_PH_0__Text Snippets__TRILIUM_PH_1__ will also appear individually, making it easy to insert them.
units.context: Slash Commands > Integration with other features

units.source: For __TRILIUM_PH_0__links__TRILIUM_PH_1__, __TRILIUM_PH_2__Link to a web page__TRILIUM_PH_3__, __TRILIUM_PH_4__Link to a note (internal link)__TRILIUM_PH_5__ and __TRILIUM_PH_6__Link to a heading or anchor__TRILIUM_PH_7__ open the __TRILIUM_PH_8__Add link__TRILIUM_PH_9__ dialog on the matching page. __TRILIUM_PH_10__Link to a web page (with icon)__TRILIUM_PH_11__ and __TRILIUM_PH_12__Link to a web page (as a card)__TRILIUM_PH_13__ also pick how the web link is displayed, as described in __TRILIUM_PH_14__Link Previews__TRILIUM_PH_15__.
